title: 听力挑战 · 比较手机型号

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Which phone do you think is better for me?
rounds.lineCn: 你觉得哪款手机更适合我?

grammar.name: 比较级 better than
grammar.note: better 是 good 的比较级,比较两个事物时使用。

options.text: I think the A9 is better for daily use.
options.feedback: 用比较级 better 给出明确推荐,符合问句。

options.text: I bought the A9 last month.
options.feedback: 谈的是购买行为,没有比较推荐。

options.text: Both phones are in my bag.
options.feedback: 只说手机位置,没有回答哪款更好。

rounds.speaker: 店员
rounds.line: What is the difference between these two models?
rounds.lineCn: 这两款型号有什么区别?

grammar.name: much + 比较级
grammar.note: much 可加强比较级,表示'大得多'。

options.text: The new one has a much larger screen.
options.feedback: much larger 强调差别明显,准确比较两款手机。

options.text: The old one is in the drawer.
options.feedback: 只说旧手机的位置,没有说明差异。

options.text: I compared them with my friend.
options.feedback: 说的是比较这个动作,没有给出比较结果。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Is the battery life good on this one?

grammar.name: 比较级表优劣
grammar.note: 用 lasts longer than 比较电池续航,than 后接比较对象。

options.text: Yes, it lasts much longer than the old one.
options.feedback: 用比较级说明续航优势,直接回答问题。

options.text: No, I left it at home.
options.feedback: 说的是手机落在家里,没有评价续航。

options.text: Yes, it cost more than my budget.
options.feedback: 谈的是价格超出预算,不是电池续航。
